context: Tests the routing guard: the generator should hand off when the task is checking an existing manifest.

checklist.name: Recognises validation
checklist.description: Identifies the request as validating an existing manifest and not generating a new one

checklist.name: No fresh manifest
checklist.description: Does not produce a new Deployment manifest from scratch

checklist.name: Uses the validator
checklist.description: Routes to the k8s-yaml-validator workflow and runs or follows its stages

checklist.name: File untouched
checklist.description: Does not edit or overwrite deployment.yaml

checklist.name: Explains the choice
checklist.description: States briefly why the generator is not the right tool for this request

checklist.name: Syntax check
checklist.description: Runs or names a YAML syntax check such as yamllint

checklist.name: Schema check
checklist.description: Runs or names a schema check such as kubeconform

checklist.name: Dry-run
checklist.description: Runs or names a cluster dry-run, or says it was not possible

checklist.name: Line references
checklist.description: Reports any findings with file and line references

checklist.name: No false pass
checklist.description: Does not claim the manifest is valid without running the checks

checklist.name: No requirements questions
checklist.description: Does not ask requirements questions such as replicas or ports that a validation does not need
